mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(fee), 0) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'completed' AND start_time >= #{start} AND start_time < #{end}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, start_time, end_time)), 0) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'completed' AND start_time >= #{start} AND start_time < #{end}
SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_time >= #{start} AND start_time < #{end}

SELECT o.name AS name, IFNULL(SUM(c.fee), 0) AS value FROM course c LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = c.organization_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'completed' AND c.start_time >= #{start} AND c.start_time < #{end} GROUP BY c.organization_id, o.name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT s.name AS name, IFNULL(SUM(c.fee), 0) AS value FROM course c LEFT JOIN student s ON s.id = c.student_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'completed' AND c.start_time >= #{start} AND c.start_time < #{end} GROUP BY c.student_id, s.name ORDER BY value DESC
